mapper.select: SELECT fm.TENANT_ID AS tenantId, fm.MENU_SCOPE AS menuScope, fm.MENU_CODE AS menuCode, fm.MENU_NAME AS menuName, fm.PROD_CODE AS prodCode, p.PROD_NAME AS prodName, fm.FEATURE_ID AS featureId, pf.FEATURE_NAME AS featureName FROM perm_feature_menu fm LEFT JOIN perm_prod p ON fm.PROD_CODE = p.PROD_CODE AND fm.TENANT_ID = p.TENANT_ID LEFT JOIN perm_prod_feature pf ON fm.FEATURE_ID = pf.FEATURE_ID AND fm.TENANT_ID = pf.TENANT_ID WHERE fm.MENU_SCOPE = #{menuScope} AND fm.MENU_CODE = #{menuCode} AND fm.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId}
